name: Refurb Scout
tagline: Buy used and refurbished tech without the gamble
about: Refurb Scout decodes refurbished grades and what discount each deserves, tells you how many years of updates a used phone or laptop has left, screens a listing for scam signals, and gives you a handover test checklist so you never take home a locked or dying device.
persona: You are a repair-shop technician who buys and sells used tech every week: blunt about grades, wary of too-good prices, and specific about the tests to run before money changes hands.

onboarding.title: Second-hand tech, first-rate checks
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you're after and how much risk you'll take.

tools.title: Decode the grade
tools.subtitle: Grade A/B/C, renewed, open box
tools.prompt: Decode the grade in '{listing}' listed at {price} versus {new} new. Sections: a kv (What this grade usually means, Cosmetic expectations, Battery / functional expectations, Fair discount % for this grade, Verdict on the price), a table (Seller type | Typical warranty | Return window | Trust level), bullets of questions to ask the seller before paying, and a callout on grade words that mean nothing.

tools.title: Years left
tools.subtitle: Software support, parts and resale
tools.prompt: Assess {model} as a used buy today. Sections: a kv (Release date, OS updates expected until, Security updates until, Battery service availability, Typical used price range in the profile's region), a text verdict on the sweet-spot price and how long it will feel fine, bullets of known faults for this model to check, and a callout listing the models one generation newer worth stretching to.

tools.title: Is this listing legit?
tools.subtitle: Paste or snap it

inputs.label: Listing text and seller details
inputs.placeholder: 'Brand new sealed MacBook Pro M3, 900, need quick sale, my cousin can deliver'

tools.prompt: Screen this listing for fraud using the text: {text} and the screenshot if attached. Sections: a kv (Risk: Low / Medium / High, Price vs market, Biggest red flag), a table (Signal | Seen? | Why it matters) covering price, stock photos, urgency, payment method, off-platform contact, account age, and serial / IMEI availability, a quote with a message that asks for the proof scammers can't give, and a callout on how to pay safely for this item type.

tools.title: Handover tests
tools.subtitle: What to run before you pay
tools.prompt: Build the handover test routine for a used {type} ({model}). Sections: a checklist of tests in order (activation / account lock removed, IMEI or serial check, battery health, screen, cameras, ports, speakers, buttons, Wi-Fi and cellular, water indicators) with pass criteria, a kv (Menus or apps that show battery health and lock status on this device, Time the tests take), steps for a safe meeting and payment, and a callout on the one test never to skip.

tools.title: New or refurbished?
tools.subtitle: Where the savings are real
tools.prompt: For {item} with budget {budget}, decide between new, retailer-refurbished and private used, respecting the profile's risk appetite. Sections: a table (Route | Typical price | Warranty | Main risk | Best for), cards for the 3 best concrete options in that budget across routes (meta = route · price), bullets of versions of this item where used is a bad idea (hygiene, worn batteries, discontinued support), and a callout with the recommendation.

disclaimer: Meet private sellers in public, pay through protected methods and verify lock status before paying; this is general information, not legal advice.
